Chemistry 2015-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2015-I.question: Electricity is produced through dry cell from
Chemistry 2015-I.explanation: (a)  Electricity  is  produced  through  dry  cell  from chemical energy. The cells from which electric energy is derived by irreversible chemical action are called primary cells. The primary cell is capable of providing an EMF when its constituent's two electrodes and a suitable electrolyte are assembled together. The three main primary cells are the Daniel cell, the Leclanche cell, and the dry cell. None of these cells can be recharged electrically.
